module.name: Concurrency Count
module.changelog: *2.0.0 (26 August 2026)* Initial release. UI module port of the Concurrency Count CLI tool. Calculates maximum concurrent calls per PJSIP trunk, extension, or group within a date range, with a Live Command Centre (AMI-backed current state, threshold alerts via a supervised PM2 worker), persistent Historic Report tabs (up to five, saved report definitions restored across sessions), an optional 'sweep' calculation engine alongside the original per-second occupancy algorithm, and email/download output.
module.description: Calculates maximum concurrent PJSIP calls per trunk, extension, or group across a date range. Companion to the Concurrency Count CLI tool (concurrency-count) shipped via IN1CLICK - NOT CURRENTLY SUITABLE FOR PRODUCTION. Read-only against asteriskcdrdb. Results can be viewed in the browser, downloaded as CSV, or emailed.
